title: Godot 2D
intro: Connect Godot to edit, run and debug 2D games in DSH.
enabledHint: Save your settings, then connect from a Godot 2D session. Turning this off stops new commands; changes already made are not undone.
projectRootHint: Absolute path containing project.godot. The editor, session workspace and bound project must agree.
godotExecutableHint: Full path to an existing Godot executable. This release supports 4.7.2 and does not install or upgrade it.
httpUnavailable: HTTP connections are not supported in this release. Saved addresses are shown for reference; select the local connection program.
bridgeExecutableHint: Select bin/python inside the environment created by the installer. Keep that environment's symlink path; do not replace it with global Python or a launcher script.
bridgeUrlHint: A dedicated loopback ws:// address with an explicit port. Configure the Godot addon to match; never take over an occupied port.
bridgeSecretRefHint: Environment variable name only, for example DSH_GAMEDEV_BRIDGE_TOKEN. Never paste the token value here.
bridgeEndpointHint: HTTP connections are not supported in this release. This field only shows a previously saved address.
httpSecretRefHint: Environment variable name only, not the secret. This field only shows a previously saved setting.
optionalHint: Allowed tools appear in development guidance after they pass the availability check. Selecting a tool does not install it or change DSH terminal permissions.
gdtoolkitPurpose: GDScript linting and formatting; inspect a formatting diff before accepting it.
imagemagickPurpose: 2D image conversion, dimensions and alpha inspection.
ffmpegPurpose: Audio/video metadata and conversion using the installed build.
optionalPathHint: Absolute path; leave blank to report it as unconfigured. Detection does not download anything.
candidates: Other art, interaction and creation tools are not installed with this plugin. Adding project addons or test frameworks requires your permission.
testsHint: Use the project's existing tests and CI. This setting does not install or remove GUT, gdUnit4, .NET or C++ test dependencies.
healthUnavailable: No connection information yet. Check the editor connection from your development session.
applied: Configuration number used by this connection
restart: Open a new Godot 2D session after changing the project, program or address, or after reloading the plugin. Re-enabling the same project can reconnect after cleanup without restarting DSH.
boundary: One development session uses the editor connection at a time. DSH permissions and approvals still apply; these settings cannot restrict file access by every local program. After cancellation or disconnection, inspect changes before retrying.
saved: Settings saved. Open a new Godot 2D session if you changed the project or connection address.
revoked: Connection disabled. No new commands will be sent. An operation already started may have changed the project; check it first.
disableFailed: Could not disable the connection. The previous switch state still applies. Retry and check the connection status.
saveFailed: Could not save, or another window changed the settings. Your draft is retained; review the latest settings and retry.
changed: The saved configuration changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained.
unavailable: Godot 2D settings are temporarily unavailable in DSH.
invalidSummary: Correct the fields below. Nothing was saved.
absolutePath: Enter an absolute path, or leave this optional field blank.
loopbackWs: Use ws://localhost, ws://127.0.0.1 or ws://[::1] with an explicit dedicated port and no credentials, query or fragment.
loopbackHttp: Use an http:// loopback endpoint with no embedded credentials, query or fragment.
envRef: Enter an environment variable name such as DSH_GAMEDEV_BRIDGE_TOKEN, or leave blank. Do not enter a secret value.
